agent_execution_manifest.primary_objective: 1:1 pixel-perfect, fully-dynamic, high-converting implementation of Gorakhpur Repairs adhering strictly to design.json, PRD.json, and schema.prisma.

strict_compliance_rules.instruction: Do NOT mock, fake, or hardcode categories, services, ratings, reviews, inspection fee, or Gorakhpur locations in any frontend component. All displayed data MUST be fetched directly from Neon PostgreSQL using Prisma Client.

Keep `page.tsx` as an async Server Component for fast DB fetching and optimal SEO. Split interactive UI (search filter bar, sticky bottom bar, lead capture form, image gallery thumbnail switcher) into dedicated Client Components ('use client') in `/components/ui/`.
On `/services/[category]`, do NOT render sub-services as messy separate cards. Feed them directly into a clean `<select>` dropdown inside the right-column lead form as specified in design.json.

Every form submission must hit `POST /api/bookings`. The handler must write the lead into the database, create an ID like `GKP-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`, trigger Brevo transactional notification, and return HTTP 201.
The sticky bottom action bar (WhatsApp, Call, Book Service) must be active on viewport width < 768px (`md:hidden`), sticky at bottom-0, z-index 50, with backdrop blur.

app.layout.tsx: Global layout with Navbar, Footer, and Google Analytics 4 Script
app.page.tsx: Server Component: Homepage with 6 appliance categories, trust badges, and locality tags

services.page.tsx: Server Component: Lists all services via Justdial card layout with Client Search Filter

[category].page.tsx: Server Component: Dynamic service detail page with gallery and sticky lead form

thank-you.page.tsx: Server Component: Confirmation card with 3-step tracker and summary from Prisma

bookings.route.ts: POST route: Validates input, saves to PostgreSQL, triggers Brevo alert, returns bookingId

ui.Navbar.tsx: Global sticky navigation bar with phone and brand logo
ui.Footer.tsx: Dark footer with SEO locality tags and company details
ui.StickyMobileBar.tsx: 'use client' fixed bottom bar for mobile screens (WhatsApp, Call, Book)
ui.LeadCaptureForm.tsx: 'use client' dynamic booking form with sub-service & area dropdowns
ui.ServiceSearchFilter.tsx: 'use client' instant client-side search input for /services
ui.ImageGallerySlider.tsx: 'use client' image slider with interactive thumbnails

lib.prisma.ts: Singleton Prisma Client instance for serverless Neon Postgres
lib.brevo.ts: Transactional email and SMS dispatcher function using Brevo API
